**Done.** A repeat of the same key within 5 minutes now drops.

The replay dropped 99 of 900. Those are the flaps in `events.js`.

Only delivered notifications reset a key's timer. A dropped repeat does not extend the window.

Good news too. `verify.js`, the checker I flagged earlier, now passes.
